title: trash restore: RESTORE_UNIQUE_VALUE_TAKEN names no field for an organization-scoped unique value another live row now holds
body:
domain:server#8 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwqTK71kjQzHae8T5J

Blocked-by: #32935
Source: out-of-scope finding of #32711 (PR #32935, Acceptance notes).

## Problem

`packages/objectql/src/recycle-bin/restore.ts` answers `RESTORE_UNIQUE_VALUE_TAKEN` by asking `uniqueViolationColumn`. For a field declared `unique: 'organization'` the index is `(organization_id, FIELD)`, so that answer is `undefined` and restoring a recycle-bin entry whose value another live row now holds reads "another record now holds a value it must keep unique (a unique value)" with no `field`.

## Do

After #32935 lands, have the restore refusal ask `uniqueViolationField` (the refusal's question, not a routing one), so it names the field and its label as the engine envelope now does. Pin SQLite and Postgres spellings plus the multi-authored-column control (still no field). Additive key on an existing refusal: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `patch`.
